t: A union of Austria, Bohemia and Hungary formed in 1526 and held together by the Habsburg dynasty, army and Catholic Church.
It stopped Ottoman expansion at Vienna in 1529 and 1683 and reconquered Hungary by the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699.
Maria Theresa and Joseph II made it a model of enlightened absolutism before it became the Austrian Empire in 1804.
dyk: The thaler, struck from the silver of Joachimsthal in Bohemia, gave its name to the dollar.
ev: Louis II dies at Mohács; Ferdinand of Austria is elected king of Bohemia and Hungary
First Ottoman siege of Vienna is repulsed
Bohemian revolt crushed at the Battle of White Mountain
Second Ottoman siege of Vienna broken at the Battle of Kahlenberg
Treaty of Karlowitz returns almost all of Hungary to Habsburg rule
Charles VI issues the Pragmatic Sanction, making the lands indivisible
Joseph II issues the Patent of Toleration and abolishes personal serfdom
Francis II proclaims himself hereditary Emperor of Austria

f.predecessor: Archduchy of Austria; Kingdom of Bohemia; Kingdom of Hungary
